_metadata.description: OT-P0-003 — guided execution where status/next act as a just-in-time context server.

requirements.title: status/next inject phase-scoped context just-in-time
requirements.description: The status/next commands return the current phase, what is next, phase-scoped required-reading + reminders, the last validation results, and current staleness — so the agent does not carry that procedural knowledge in context.

validation.notes: next returns the earliest unfinished phase + its scoped reading/reminders; target api/internal/execution.
CLI: status/next output shape includes validation + staleness summary; target cli/domains/execution.

requirements.title: Full vs partial completion and resume point are computed
requirements.description: Whether a run completed the whole plan or part of it, and where to resume, are derived from phase status — not narrated by the agent. A partial run yields a deterministic resume point.

validation.notes: Resume point = earliest non-done phase; full/partial derived from phase status set; target api/internal/execution.
